content.short: Mocossi Planet is soon to be the 1st Cardano P2E virtual pet game. The official breeding game launched March 16th.
content.description:
In 2048, advancements in science and technology enabled mankind to expand the search for interstellar planets in the universe. The search uncovered an Earth-like planet without any signs of humans and that is home to several intelligent alien species named Mocomon. After years of study, scientists found that the adorable inhabitants of this extraterrestrial space could coexist with earthly humans. Consequently, countries began sending more and more hooomans to inhabit the planet. As time passed, we entered a new evolutionary era, one in which we live in harmony and peace with our alien friends, the Mocomons.

Building on this concept, we are delighted to introduce Mocossi Planet, a game where participants can play and earn by taking care of their virtual pets. Basically, players' missions are to raise and bond with their Mocomons like they would with their real pets. Strongly bonded relationships will be rewarded with our in-game currency.

Our first launch included 10,000 adorable and unique Mocomons named ITO, which will soon become characters in our game. They were distributed for 35 ADA each and sold out in just three days. Currently, we are working hard to deliver the breeding feature, which will allow two ITOs to be paired and generate a second-generation ITO.

Genesis holders can enjoy early access to the game, earn in-game currency, purchase properties and lands at a discount, and receive exclusive NFTs. Non-genesis holders can also earn from the game and vote to determine its future.
